units.source_text: 因此，我只能把这事件当做旧石版印刷似的光景来回忆……

en.t: Therefore, I can only remember this incident as a scene like an old lithograph...

units.source_text: 有为子穿过游廊，冲着御堂的黑暗在呼唤。

en.t: Uiko passed through the corridor and called into the darkness of the hall.

units.source_text: 有为子同他谈了些什么。

en.t: Uiko spoke with him about something.

units.source_text: 男人持手枪冲到台阶半道上开始射击。

en.t: The man, holding a pistol, rushed halfway up the steps and began shooting.

units.source_text: 应战的宪兵也从石阶半道的树丛中开枪还击。

en.t: The military policeman who answered fire also shot back from the trees halfway up the stone steps.
The man prepared to fire again,

units.source_text: 他冲着企图向游廊那边逃跑的有为子的背后连发了几枪。

en.t: and he fired several shots in succession at Uiko's back as she tried to flee toward the corridor.
Uiko fell to the ground at the sound of the shots.

units.source_text: 男人又把枪口对准自己的太阳穴开枪……

en.t: Then the man pointed the muzzle at his own temple and fired...
